many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
H,W=I.shape
def find(I,O,mode='exact'):
    nh,nw=None,None
    results=[]
    for hh in range(1,H+1):
        for ww in range(1,W+1):
            if H%H or W%ww: continue
            # majority tile
            cnt=Counter((i%hh,j%ww,I[i,j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W))
            m=(cnt.most_common(1))[0][0]
            T={k:v for k,v,c in cnt.items() if (k,m)[1]==c}
            if any(k not in T for k in [(i%hh,j%ww) for i in range(hh) for j in range(ww)]): continue
            pred=np.array([[T[(i%hh,j%ww)] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)])
            ok=(pred==O).all()
            nbad=(pred!=I).mean()*100
            if ok or mode=='scan':
                results.append((hh,ww,nbad,ok,T))
    return results
r=find(I,O)
print(r[:8])

from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cands=[]
    vals=set(v for row in I for v in row)
    # noise color = the color minimizing mismatches over smallest tile? Instead, search all nc,p,q, collect those with minimal mis and pick by tie-breaks consistent with demos.
    best=None
    for nc in sorted(vals):
        for p in range(1,h+1):
            for q in range(1,w+1):
                mv={}
                ok=True
                for a in range(p):
                    for b in range(q):
                        vals2=[I[r][c] for r in range(a,h,p) for c in range(b,w,q) if I[r][c]!=nc]
                        if not vals2: ok=False; break
                        mv[(a,b)]=Counter(vals2).most_common(1)[0][0]
                    if not ok: break
                if not ok: continue
                out=[[mv[(r%p,c%q)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
                # cost: measure disagreement among non-noise cells within blocks that are ambiguous? use simple: min over p,q of sum_{block} fraction non-top
                tot=sum(len(v) for (_,v) in mv.values())  # careful: len(values counted per block already
                bad=sum(len(vals)-Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][1] for (_,vals) in [])
                # compute directly
                tot_={}
                for (a,b),v in mv.items(): tot_[(a,b)]=1
                # simpler: define cost as sum over blocks of fraction of non-majority non-noise samples
                blkcost=[]
                for a in range(p):
                    for b in range(q):
                        vs=[I[r][c] for r in range(a,h,p) for c in range(b,w,q) if I[r][c]!=nc]
                        n=len(vs); cnt=Counter(vs); top,nn=cnt.most_common(1)[0]; blkcost.append((n-nn)/n)
                sc=sum(blkcost)/(p*q)
                key=(sc,int(nc),p,q)
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,out,sc)
    return best[1],best[0][1],best[0][2],best[0][3]
for name,(I,O) in [('5',(D5i,D5o)),('6',(D6i,D6o)),('7',(D7i,D7o))]:
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); oh,ow=len(O),len(O[0])
    out,nc,p,q=f(I)
    mis=sum(out[r][c]!=O[r][c] for r in range(oh) for c in range(ow))
    print(name,'noise',nc,'tile',(p,q),'mis',mis,'outsize',(len(out),len(out[0])))

def f(I):

                        if not vs: ok=False; break
                        mv[(a,b)]=Counter(vs).most_common(1)[0][0]
                    if not ok: break
                if not ok: continue
                tot=sum(len(Counter([I[r][c] for r in range(a,h,p) for c in range(b,w,q)]))-Counter([I[r][c] for r in range(a,h,p) for c in range(b,w,q)]) for a in range(p) for b in range(q)]

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

                out=[[mv[(r%p,c%q)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
                tot=sum(len([I[r][c] for r in range(a,h,p) for c in range(b,w,q)]) for a in range(p) for b in range(q))
